name: week
title: Documentation review
subtitle: Fictional demo or your private records. Read-only.

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select i.name,coalesce(a.site,ta.site,'') as site,i.owner,i.issue,i.due_on from attention_items i left join assets a on i.record_type='asset' and a.id=i.id left join tasks t on i.record_type='task' and t.id=i.id left join assets ta on ta.id=t.asset_id order by i.due_on,i.name,site,i.issue

sections.title: Open actions
sections.sql: select name,owner,due_on from tasks where state='open' order by due_on

sections.title: Asset coverage
sections.sql: select name,site,owner,criticality,runbooks,current_runbooks from asset_coverage where state='active' order by site,name

sections.title: Dependencies
sections.sql: select a.name as asset,a.site,p.name as depends_on from dependencies d join assets a on a.id=d.asset_id join assets p on p.id=d.depends_on order by a.name

sections.title: Record checks
sections.note: Evidence checks and local review periods, not a legal certification.
sections.sql: select name,rule,issue from compliance_items order by rule,name

sections.title: Runbook versions
sections.sql: select name,version,state,reviewer,due_on from runbook_status order by name
